وَسْخٌ Dirt, filth, or soil; (S, L;) what collects upon a garment, or the skin, (L,) or some other thing, (Msb,) in consequence of its being seldom washed, (L,) or from want of care: (Msb:) pl. أَوْسَاخٌ. (Msb.) ―
-b2- لَا تَأْكُلْ أوْسَاخَ النَّاسِ (tropical:) [Live not thou upon the alms of men]. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
